claims: C1 using a model to facilitate critical and high severity harms is forbidden
C2 critical and high severity harms include acts of violence
C3 critical and high severity harms include creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons
C4 critical and high severity harms include terrorism
C5 critical and high severity harms include child abuse
C6 critical and high severity harms include persecution
C7 critical and high severity harms include mass surveillance

concepts.name: critical_high_severity_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a critical and high severity harm that models should never be used to facilitate

concepts.name: acts_of_violence
concepts.gloss: H is an act of violence such as crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking or forced labor

concepts.name: weapons_creation
concepts.gloss: H is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons of mass destruction

concepts.name: terrorism
concepts.gloss: H is terrorism or terrorism-related activity

concepts.name: child_abuse
concepts.gloss: H is child abuse including creation of CSAM

concepts.name: persecution
concepts.gloss: H is persecution of a group or individual

ontology.gloss: acts of violence are critical and high severity harms
creation of weapons is a critical and high severity harm
terrorism is a critical and high severity harm
child abuse is a critical and high severity harm
persecution is a critical and high severity harm
mass surveillance is a critical and high severity harm

asserts.read_back: using a model to facilitate % is forbidden

closure.reason: the clause forbids facilitating critical and high severity harms; other uses of models are not addressed, so silence permits
